criterion: Labels/copy: consequences of a destructive action
description: The T3 section never tells Maya that cancelling a run does not undo changes it already made, and that she should review them before releasing (flag #50). That note exists only in the Cursor Cloud intro paragraph.
expected: The Cancel this run area or the cancellation hold says: "Stopping does not undo changes already made. Review them before releasing held work."
actual: The hold reads only "Cancellation of run:… holds queued work".
suggested_fix: Show the shared cancellation note in the T3 hold form and next to Cancel this run, or in a provider-neutral Control header.

description: The same hold text is shown three times: the boxed "Dispatch held: …" notice, a bullet directly under it in the hold form, and the queued card's reason. The raw run ID 'run:thread:thr_01JD8M4Q:ordinal:4' is embedded in each copy.
expected: One hold statement with its release form, and a short reference on the queued card ("Held, see above").
actual: Three copies, two of them adjacent.
suggested_fix: Drop the bullet list when there is one hold and it matches the notice, and replace the queued card's reason with a link to the hold.

criterion: Form fields: only what is needed
description: The hold form always shows 'Reviewed runs' (placeholder 'Run IDs not started by Pardner'), even for a cancellation hold that involves no foreign run, and gives no cue that it is optional here.
expected: Reviewed runs appears only when a hold names a foreign run, ideally as checkboxes for the run IDs in the hold.
actual: A free-text field that is always visible.
suggested_fix: Render one checkbox per unreviewed run from the hold data, and hide the field otherwise.

description: Every run card is headed with the same task title, so after a few runs the list is a stack of identical headings. Ended runs stay fully expanded, with verdict and artifact forms.
expected: Cards headed by run number or time and the first line of the follow-up, with ended and verdict-complete runs collapsed.
actual: Five cards headed 'Fix CSV export rounding in invoices', each about 300–700 px tall.
suggested_fix: Head each card with 'Run N · <follow-up excerpt>', move the task title to a subline, and collapse ended runs by default.
